title: Data and code for forecasting annual counts of large wildfires in Spain
description: Software, harmonised annual data, derived results and reproducibility code supporting a study of large-wildfire counts in Spain using ARIMA, ARIMAX and negative-binomial time-series models. Version 1.3 freezes all model fitting through 2025 and archives the prospectively observed 2026 holdout through 31 August 2026 (44 large wildfires; 264,656 ha affected) separately from the historical modelling dataset. Later 2026 European wildfire developments are intentionally not used to refit or select models in this release.
notes: Version 1.3.0. Models are frozen through 2025. The 2026 provisional snapshots are prospective holdout observations only and are never used for model fitting or selection. Code is licensed MIT; original derived tables/documentation are CC BY 4.0; source datasets retain their original terms.
